authority.statusRule: Recovered family action and Path names outrank derived explanation. Identity/continuity mathematics, machinery causality and technology-basis embodiments are DERIVED unless separately sourced. Numeric coefficients and philosophical interpretations remain PROPOSED or UNRESOLVED unless adopted.

stateMap.meaning: Displacement maps a bounded protected source state to an admissible nonlocal target state; it is not modeled as continuous traversal through intervening space.

compatibilityDistance.meaning: Target-state compatibility is a weighted distance over required state descriptors. The weighting matrix is family/configuration specific and not a universal setting constant.

continuityMargin.expression: mu_I = I_available - I_required(payload_class, complexity, reference_quality, separation, environment)
continuityMargin.meaning: Commit requires positive identity/continuity margin under the configured invariant set. The setting does not equate this engineering test with a universal philosophical proof of personal identity.

coverageMargin.expression: mu_C = min_{x in Omega_payload} c(x) - c_required
coverageMargin.meaning: Whole-object protected-state coverage is governed by the weakest certified region, not average coverage.

targetCovariance.expression: Sigma_T = J_n Sigma_nav J_n^T + Sigma_ref + Sigma_model + Sigma_grav + Sigma_occ
targetCovariance.meaning: Remote target uncertainty combines navigation, reference, model, gravity and occupancy uncertainty; correlated sources must not be counted as independent confirmations.

commitAdmissibility.expression: A_commit = (d_C <= d_max) AND (mu_I > 0) AND (mu_C > 0) AND target_authenticated AND target_unoccupied AND reserve_valid
commitAdmissibility.meaning: Hard safety conditions are vetoes, not weighted preferences.

safetyHorizon.expression: T_precommit >= t_detect + t_auth + t_model + t_crosscheck + t_command + t_state + t_recovery + t_margin
safetyHorizon.meaning: Higher performance requires enough time to detect target change, authenticate evidence, solve state compatibility, cross-check invariants, prepare the protected state and retain recovery authority.

pathStages.name: Quantum State Conveyor
pathStages.breakthrough: Demonstrate controlled nonlocal mapping of simple prepared states.
pathStages.limit: No living or macroscopic payload; extreme preparation purity.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Fixed preparation/readout apparatus and reference-purity metrology.

pathStages.name: Gram-to-Tonne Displacement Vault
pathStages.breakthrough: Extend compatibility mapping to complex bounded matter states.
pathStages.limit: Large isolation vaults, reference stores and strict completeness tests.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Larger state cages, environmental isolation and high-capacity reference storage.

pathStages.name: Macroscopic Phase Chamber
pathStages.breakthrough: Preserve defined continuity invariants over complex payloads and longer separation.
pathStages.limit: Prepared endpoints and whole-payload enclosure remain dominant constraints.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Continuous enclosure metrology, stronger reconciliation systems and precommit continuity proof.

pathStages.name: Beacon-Coupled Vessel Displacement
pathStages.breakthrough: Resolve a remote compatible target state against authenticated beacon observations.
pathStages.limit: Beacon/reference trust, endpoint occupancy and whole-vessel coverage become flight critical.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Shipboard state cage, beacon links, remote exclusion sensing and independent reference cross-checks.

pathStages.name: Autonomous Phase Drive
pathStages.breakthrough: Infer target compatibility without a fully prepared receiver.
pathStages.limit: Target uncertainty and model error replace prepared-endpoint dependence.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Higher-resolution sensing, onboard target models, stronger cages and explicit uncertainty vetoes.

pathStages.name: Strategic Nonlocal Transit Core
pathStages.breakthrough: Optimize target-state compatibility across long baselines and imperfect observations.
pathStages.utility: Long-baseline strategic displacement with bounded uncertainty.
pathStages.limit: Reference provenance, state-buffer integrity, fallback targets and continuity margin dominate.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Strategic reference networks, redundant state proofs, larger buffers and protected recovery authority.

pathStages.name: Compact Identity-Preserving Displacer
pathStages.breakthrough: Continuously solve continuity constraints and target compatibility in compact real time.
pathStages.utility: Small platforms obtain high-quality autonomous displacement.
pathStages.limit: Compactness increases sensitivity to reference trust, state-media health and common-mode faults.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Dense state-active materials, redundant local reference stores, sectional coverage and receding-horizon invariant checking.

machinery.function: Provide state preparation, mapping, target lock, reconciliation and protected recovery energy.
machinery.failureExposure: bus asymmetry, reserve depletion, transient collapse

machinery.function: Realize the nonlocal mapping operator over the certified protected payload state.
machinery.failureExposure: mapping nonconvergence, mode contamination, incomplete state transfer

machinery.function: Maintain complete protected-state coverage over hull, crew, cargo and certified appendages.
machinery.failureExposure: coverage hole, boundary uncertainty, uncatalogued external geometry

machinery.function: Measure and preserve the configured identity/continuity invariants and reference history.
machinery.failureExposure: reference drift, common-mode corruption, invariant disagreement

machinery.function: Establish target compatibility, occupancy, environmental state and provenance from independent observations.
machinery.failureExposure: stale beacon, correlated evidence, target alias, occupancy uncertainty

machinery.function: Arbitrate candidate targets, hard vetoes, commit timing and post-event reconciliation.
machinery.failureExposure: premature commit, veto bypass, estimator/controller disagreement

machinery.function: Verify arrival state, isolate anomalies, restore normal interfaces and retain abort/recovery authority.
machinery.failureExposure: reconciliation mismatch, trapped protected state, recovery exhaustion

machinery.function: Provide independent timing, logging, thermal control, interlocks and abort authority.
machinery.failureExposure: common-mode clock loss, thermal saturation, audit-log loss, interlock defeat

powerModel.expression: E_event = E_prepare + E_reference + E_target_lock + E_map + E_reconcile + E_recovery
powerModel.reserveRule: E_recovery is protected and cannot be traded away for marginal range or schedule performance.
powerModel.scalingRule: Higher energy alone cannot compensate for incomplete state coverage, weak references, incompatible target state or failed continuity proof.

navigationControl.commitRule: Commit only when target authentication, compatibility, exclusion, continuity, coverage and recovery vetoes all pass independently.
navigationControl.identityRule: The controller reports which engineering invariants were preserved and their evidence. It does not upgrade an engineering continuity check into an absolute metaphysical claim.

steps: Inventory the complete protected payload and deployed geometry.
Authenticate continuity references and verify independent evidence roots.
Measure minimum cage coverage and reconcile against current physical configuration.
Build target-state estimate with covariance and occupancy exclusion.
Reserve recovery energy and reject commit if any hard margin fails.
Freeze commit countdown.
Separate independent from correlated target observations.
Recompute candidate target states and compatibility distances.
Discard candidates requiring averaged occupancy or unauthenticated references.
Resume only after one admissible target remains or abort.
Hold state mapping before commit.
Identify which invariant channel disagrees and its provenance.
Cross-check against isolated local reference stores.
Treat common-source agreement as one evidence family, not multiple votes.
Abort if required invariant set cannot be certified.
Maintain protected state until arrival observations stabilize.
Compare arrival state against committed invariant and configuration records.
Quarantine mismatched subsystems or payload zones.
Release ordinary interfaces only after recovery reserve and environment are verified.
Preserve event evidence for maintenance and forensic review.

maintenance.purpose: Find weak local coverage, configuration drift and uncatalogued geometry before they become commit hazards.
Detect multiple channels that actually depend on one corrupted clock, beacon, model or archive.
Measure mapper/buffer drift, hysteresis and damaged active media.
Determine whether growing disagreement is sensor noise, environmental change, model failure or reference poisoning.
Demonstrate that arrival verification and protected recovery remain available independently of the nominal mapper.

signatures.strategicConsequence: Mature autonomous systems can reduce dependence on obvious fixed receivers, but displacement events and their reference/sensing preparation remain potentially observable.

failureModels.cause: One payload region falls below required protected-state coverage.
failureModels.effect: Mapping becomes inadmissible or risks incomplete/undefined transfer.

failureModels.cause: Multiple nonlocal target states remain compatible within current evidence.
failureModels.effect: Controller cannot establish unique safe destination correspondence.

failureModels.cause: Required configured invariants disagree or lack independent evidence.
failureModels.effect: Commit veto; post-event occurrence triggers quarantine and forensic review.

failureModels.cause: Clock, beacon, archive or model provenance is stale, compromised or falsely treated as independent.
failureModels.effect: High-confidence solution may refer to the wrong source or target state.

failureModels.cause: Target volume cannot be proven free of incompatible matter/state.
failureModels.effect: Commit veto or catastrophic target-state incompatibility if safeguards fail.

failureModels.cause: Arrival measurements do not converge on the committed expected state within tolerance.
failureModels.effect: Protected quarantine, restricted subsystem release or recovery action.

failureModels.cause: Energy or state-media authority required for protected reconciliation is consumed by the nominal transit.
failureModels.effect: Arrival may succeed but safe normalization cannot be guaranteed.

failureModels.cause: Payload, appendages, repairs or cargo changed after the certified source-state model was built.
failureModels.effect: Coverage and state model no longer describe the actual displaced object.

infrastructure.role: Provide independently verifiable target state, time, environment and exclusion observations without themselves guaranteeing safety.
Maintain signed historical state/reference chains used to detect drift, aliasing and false independence.
At earlier maturity, reduce target-state uncertainty and provide controlled reconciliation environments.
At higher maturity, support long-baseline target estimation, fallback targets and provenance cross-checks.

scaling.payload: State complexity, surface/volume coverage, articulation, crew/cargo change and appendage dynamics can grow faster than simple mass.
scaling.distance: Longer baselines primarily increase target/reference covariance and environmental/model uncertainty unless infrastructure reduces them.
scaling.compactness: P6 compact machinery replaces bulk with denser active media, faster solving and distributed references; it does not remove whole-object coverage or recovery requirements.
scaling.parallelism: Multiple mapper modules improve capacity only when their references, cages and recovery systems avoid common-mode dependence.

hardGuards: Do not describe phase displacement as continuous flight through intervening space.
Do not treat identity/continuity engineering checks as an absolute philosophical proof unless setting canon explicitly adopts one.
Do not average away occupancy conflicts or local coverage holes.
Do not count correlated references as independent confirmations.
Do not infer race ownership, inventor, manufacturer, historical date or prevalence from technology basis.
Do not convert PROPOSED numerical coefficients into canon through generated repetition.
Do not spend protected recovery reserve to improve nominal range or schedule.
Do not silently convert a training accident, thesis example or patent-class record into setting history.
